title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
script:
Mistral released a new trillion-parameter AI model yesterday, October twenty-ninth, twenty-twenty-six.
This model is designed to help organizations manage their own cyber defenses.
Mistral provides the model weights, allowing companies to run it on their own infrastructure.
CEO Arthur Mensch argues this transparency offers control that closed models cannot match.
It is the largest open-weights model yet, specifically optimized for detecting complex digital threats.
The release aims to reduce reliance on third-party providers for critical security tasks.
Would you trust an open-source model to secure your private data?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but visual execution is repetitive and fails to maintain engagement.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Remove the date; it is redundant with the on-screen text and slows the hook.
LINE 7: Make the question more provocative, e.g., 'Would you trust an open-weights model with your company's crown jewels?'
